name: Groupama group
note: French insurance group organised on mutual principles (groupama.com: 'Un groupe mutualiste'); its organisation page names Groupama Assurances Mutuelles as the entity piloting the group's operational activities, with the regional Caisses as its caisses adhérentes. Owned by its sociétaires (members) rather than shareholders; no state or fund owner identified. The regional mutual Groupama Paris Val de Loire is recorded separately (groupama-pvl-owner).
